meta.description: Ln3+ 4f^N multiplet (2S+1)L_J barycenter energies in LaF3, cm-1, relative to lowest crystal-field (Stark) level of ground multiplet (Carnall's scale). Energies up to 52,000 cm-1.

fields.source: exp = mean of all observed Stark levels of a complete multiplet (Carnall 1989 tables); calc = calculated
fields.E_exp_mean_observed: mean of observed Stark levels assigned to this multiplet (may be partial; n_exp_observed)
fields.E_carnall_calc_bary: mean of Carnall 1989 calculated Stark levels assigned to this multiplet
fields.E_calc_bary: mean of recomputed CF levels (qlanth + Carnall params) assigned by dominant multiplet character
fields.E_freeion_calc: intermediate-coupling free-ion eigenvalue from same parameters with B^k_q=0 (J-mixing ignored)
fields.composition: free-ion eigenvector composition in SL basis (seniority-indexed labels as in qlanth, e.g. 2H2 = second 2H term)
fields.seniority_label: dominant SL term with Nielson-Koster seniority index

sources: Carnall, Goodman, Rajnak, Rana, J. Chem. Phys. 90, 3443 (1989) + ANL-88-8 Stark-level tables, as digitized in qlanth repo data/Carnall.xls (github.com/zia-lab/qlanth, sheet '<Ion>3+')

Recomputed here: qlanth pyql sparse effective Hamiltonian (Lizarazo-Ferro et al., PRB 113, 075127 (2026)) evaluated with Carnall 1989 Table-1 parameters (qlanth data/carnall.py; M2=0.56M0, M4=0.38M0, P4=0.75P2, P6=0.5P2, spin-spin off, hole-conjugation per qlanth), full C2v-approx CF diagonalization; shifted onto Carnall's energy scale

Ce.method: mean of all observed Stark levels (complete multiplet)
